question: A heavy round plate of metal thrown by an athlete
explanation: Discus is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: चक्राकार फेंक प्रतियोगिता. Example: “The athlete threw the discus farther than anyone else in the competition.”

question: The state of being deprived of a right or privilege, especially the right to vote
explanation: Disenfranchisement is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मताधिकार से वंचित करना. Example: “The law was criticised because it could lead to the disenfranchisement of certain voters.”

question: An act that makes one feel morally bad or ashamed
explanation: Disgraceful is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: शर्मनाक. Example: “Cheating an elderly person is a disgraceful act.”

question: Disappointed and annoyed about something
explanation: Disgruntled is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: असंतुष्ट. Example: “The disgruntled employees complained about the sudden change in working hours.”

question: Change the appearance to deceive or to hide the identity
explanation: Disguise is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: भेष बदलना. Example: “He wore a disguise to hide his identity.”

question: Break up into small parts as the result of impact or decay
explanation: Disintegrate is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: विघटित हो जाना. Example: “The old building began to disintegrate after years of neglect.”

question: Causing a mood of gloom and depression
explanation: Dismal is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: निराशापूर्ण. Example: “The team had a dismal performance and lost the match badly.”

question: To throw an event into confusion or disorder
explanation: Disrupt is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: तितर-बितर करना. Example: “The protest disrupted traffic in the city centre.”

question: A range of different things
explanation: Diversity is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: विविधता. Example: “The university celebrates the diversity of its students.”

question: One thing that can be divided
explanation: Divisible is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: भाज्य. Example: “Twenty-four is divisible by six.”

question: A number which is used to divide another number
explanation: Divisor is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: भाजक. Example: “In 20 ÷ 5 = 4, five is the divisor.”

question: To reveal a secret
explanation: Divulge is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: प्रकट करना, भेद खोलना. Example: “The journalist refused to divulge the source of the information.”

question: Country treated as permanent home by an individual
explanation: Domicile is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मूल निवास. Example: “For legal purposes, his domicile is recorded as the city where he permanently lives.”

question: An area of land that is controlled by a ruler
explanation: Dominion is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: अधिराज्य. Example: “The king once exercised dominion over the entire region.”

question: Not active or growing
explanation: Dormant is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: निष्क्रिय. Example: “The volcano has remained dormant for many years.”

question: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution
explanation: Dormitory is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: शयनागार. Example: “The students returned to their dormitory after dinner.”

question: Situated on back
explanation: Dorsal is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: पीठ सम्बन्धी. Example: “The dorsal fin of the fish helps it maintain stability.”

question: Increase their commitment
explanation: Double down is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: दोगुना प्रयास करना, दोहरा दांव लगाना. Example: “Despite criticism, the company decided to double down on its investment.”

question: A heavy fall of rain that often starts suddenly
explanation: Downpour is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मूसलाधार बारिश. Example: “A sudden downpour flooded several streets.”

question: A game in which no one wins
explanation: Draw is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: अनिर्णित. Example: “The match ended in a draw after neither team scored.”

question: The nest of a squirrel, typically in the form of a mass of twigs in a tree
explanation: Drey is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: गिलहरी का घोंसला. Example: “The squirrel disappeared into its drey high in the tree.”

question: Light rain falling in small drops
explanation: Drizzle is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: बूंदाबांदी. Example: “A light drizzle continued throughout the morning.”

question: Mania for travel
explanation: Dromomania is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: यात्रा की धुन. Example: “His dromomania made him constantly dream of travelling to new places.”

question: Dry weather with no rainfall
explanation: Drought is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: सूखा. Example: “The region suffered a severe drought after months without rain.”

question: A herd or flock of animals being driven in a body
explanation: Drove is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: झुंड. Example: “A drove of cattle was being taken to the market.”

question: Capable of being bent or pulled into different shapes
explanation: Ductile is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: तन्य. Example: “Copper is ductile enough to be drawn into thin wires.”

question: A contest between two people to settle a point of honour
explanation: Duel is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: द्वंद्व युद्ध. Example: “The two rivals challenged each other to a duel to settle the matter.”

question: One who can't speak
explanation: Dumb is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: गूंगा. Example: “The character in the story was dumb and communicated through gestures.”

question: Something that is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker
explanation: Durable is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: टिकाऊ. Example: “This material is durable enough to withstand heavy use.”

question: A person, animal or plant much below the usual height
explanation: Dwarf is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: बौना. Example: “The gardener planted a dwarf variety of the tree in a small pot.”

question: A wall built to prevent the sea or a river from flooding an area
explanation: Dyke is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: बांध. Example: “The dyke protected the nearby village from flooding.”

question: Succession of rulers belonging to one family
explanation: Dynasty is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: राजवंश. Example: “The dynasty ruled the kingdom for several generations.”

question: A disorder that involves difficulty in reading or interpreting words
explanation: Dyslexia is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: अक्षरों को पढ़ने में कठिनाई होने वाला मानसिक रोग. Example: “Her dyslexia made reading difficult, but she developed effective learning strategies.”

question: A wooden frame for holding an artist's work while it is being painted or drawn
explanation: Easel is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: कैनवास को रखने का लकड़ी का ढांचा. Example: “The artist placed the unfinished painting on an easel.”

question: One who listens secretly to private conversation
explanation: Eavesdropper is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: छिपकर बातें सुनने वाला. Example: “The eavesdropper secretly listened to their private conversation.”

question: A man with abnormal habits
explanation: Eccentric is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: विचित्र. Example: “His eccentric habits often surprised his neighbours.”

question: Repetition of a sound caused by reflection of sound waves
explanation: Echo is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: प्रतिध्वनि. Example: “Her voice produced an echo in the empty hall.”

question: One who studies and cares about environment
explanation: Ecologist is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: पर्यावरण वैज्ञानिक. Example: “The ecologist studied how pollution was affecting the local river.”

question: Study of the interaction of people with their environment
explanation: Ecology is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: पर्यावरण विज्ञान. Example: “Ecology examines how living organisms interact with their environment.”

question: Careful in the spending of money, time, etc.
explanation: Economical is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: किफायती. Example: “Buying in bulk can be economical when the items will actually be used.”

question: Feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement
explanation: Ecstatic is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मुग्धावस्था. Example: “She was ecstatic when she learned that she had won the scholarship.”

question: A thing fit to be eaten
explanation: Edible is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: खाद्य. Example: “The fruit looks unusual, but it is perfectly edible.”

question: Instruct or improve someone morally or intellectually
explanation: Edify is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: उपदेश देना. Example: “The documentary was designed to edify young viewers.”

question: To prepare written material for publication by correcting or modifying it
explanation: Edit is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: संपादन करना. Example: “She had to edit the article before submitting it for publication.”

question: Rub or wipe out
explanation: Efface is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मिटाना. Example: “The repeated rubbing gradually effaced the writing on the board.”

question: A change which is the result of an act or some cause
explanation: Effect is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: प्रभाव. Example: “The new rule had a noticeable effect on attendance.”

question: Man behaving more like a woman than as a man
explanation: Effeminate is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: नारी जैसा. Example: “The character was described as effeminate in the novel.”

question: Give off gas bubbles
explanation: Effervescent is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: (तरल का) बुलबुले देना. Example: “The tablet became effervescent when dropped into water.”

question: Productive and achieved maximum output with minimum wasted effort or expense
explanation: Efficient is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: कुशल. Example: “The new system is more efficient and saves both time and money.”

question: A person who believes in the equality of all people
explanation: Egalitarian is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: समानाधिकारवादी. Example: “He supports an egalitarian society in which everyone has equal rights.”

question: One who is preoccupied with his own interests
explanation: Egoist is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: अहंकारी. Example: “An egoist is often more concerned with his own interests than with others.”

question: A person who speaks always in praise of himself // A person who is excessively conceited and self-absorbed
explanation: Egotist is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: अहंवादी. Example: “The egotist kept talking about his own achievements.”

question: Outrageous and disgraceful
explanation: Egregious is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: बेहद खराब. Example: “The official's egregious mistake caused serious problems.”

question: All the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election
explanation: Electorate is the correct one-word substitution for the given phrase. हिंदी: मतदाता. Example: “The entire electorate will have the opportunity to vote in the election.”
